text: BRL-0148 changed the gameplay framing (uncommitted at time of writing; see BRL-0148 spec): vertical FOV 30° (reference 2.21:1 aspect and narrower; wider windows keep the reference horizontal FOV, so vertical FOV shrinks), elevation 55°, camera distance 566 units (camera height ~464, ground offset ~325 behind the look target). The visible ground spans about 4.9 cells (156 units) toward the camera and 7.1 cells (228 units) away. View-space depth to the visible ground is roughly 460 units at the bottom edge and 675 at the top (ray length ~477-698). The default 150-unit shadow range still covers no gameplay geometry; extending shadows would need a maximum distance of roughly 700-750 units.

Confirm the arena cast-shadow decision. Recommendation: Option A on the High tier only (one cascade over the visible ground; Medium and Low keep shadow maps off). On the Apple M6 it costs ~0.2 ms GPU vs off, is ~0.2 ms cheaper than today's empty 4-cascade pass, and every frame stays at 120 Hz; captures show clearer depth on all three themes with tiles, Hot Zone, rings and aim lanes unaffected (unlit). The working tree implements A. Choose A or B?
suggestions: A on High only (recommended; keep the working tree)
B: shadow maps off on every tier (set High shadow_maps: false, drop arena_shadow_cascades)
